title: AR-Assisted Meridian Localization Using Ultrasonic Tomography for Precision Acupuncture
content: Accurate localization of meridian points is essential for effective acupuncture treatment, yet conventional palpation-based methods suffer from variability across practitioners. We propose an AR-assisted framework that overlays meridian maps onto patients ’ bodies using ultrasonic computed tomography (UCT) for internal tissue guidance. A deep learning–based point cloud segmentation network extracts bony landmarks from UCT scans, enabling precise anatomical registration. In trials on 25 volunteers, localization error was reduced from 6.4 mm (manual palpation) to 2. 1 mm (AR-assisted). Setup time decreased by 35%, while user satisfaction scores improved by 42%. Results suggest AR + UCT integration can standardize acupuncture practice and enhance therapeutic accuracy.
